orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia,Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
A.O. No. 216 of 2020
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This case has been heard through video 
conferencing.
Mr. Ajay Singh Bisht, Addl. Chief Standing 
Counsel for the State/appellant.
There are certain defects in the appeal, as the 
appellant has not annexed the entire documents.
Let the appellant do the needful and supply the 
relevant documents, within two weeks.
The appeal is also belated by 184 days, which 
is accompanied by a delay condonation application.
Since it is a commercial dispute, and an 
expeditious disposal is to be made, we hereby direct 
the appellant to give a prior notice to the respondent 
about the filing of the appeal, within a week.
List this case on 18.11.2020.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 31.10.2020
Avneet/
